note:
The coach DEPARTING, with its wheels turning. Eight frames: each wheel rotated by the fraction of a revolution its own radius makes over the same ground, so the rear (r144) and the front (r114) turn at DIFFERENT rates. That difference is what reads as rolling rather than spinning.

TURNED OFF TWICE AND BOTH TIMES BY ACCIDENT. 2ab0616 built these eight. 1bf5d41 painted the case off the closed-door rack and rebuilt both closed clips from the corrected source -- 'walk is the same frame' -- which collapsed eight frames to one and froze the wheels; the commit message says it plainly and nobody read it as a loss. Rebuilt here from what SHIPS: the full-res 447 body 4f9bcf6 installed, which already has the case off the rack, rather than from the source that predates both fixes.

The wheel sprites are authored against a 1728x703 body and the shipped one is 1128x447, so centres and radii are scaled on the way in. They were cut and rotatable in art/objects/coach/ the whole time, through both freezes.

THE HORSES' LEGS STILL DO NOT MOVE, and this does not change that. They are drawn inside the body and overlap each other, so a leg cycle needs painted masks or new art. Recorded rather than hidden.
